name: campusimi
description: Private anonymous college social network (dev-only, local Cloudflare stack)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/api" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace apps/api && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
